description.value:
You've mastered the fundamentals of technology, both academic and hands-on. Increase your Intelligence score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

You gain proficiency in Technology, or expertise in it if already proficient. You also learn the repair droid tech power, which you can cast once using scavenged materials, without a wristpad and without spending tech points; you regain this use after a long rest.
